2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report (Fir) in Crime No.158 of
2023 registered with the Karanja Police Station District Washim for the offence punishable under
Sections 406, 420, 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.

Learned Counsel for the applicant took us through the contents of the FIR to impress that the principal allegations are against Manish Jain Kotecha and Aashish Dorkar relating to misappropriation and cheating.
4. According to the applicant, he merely a Godown owner, which has been stored some of the pulses for certain period, which he released, having no direct role in the transaction.

5. Issue notice to the non-applicants, returnable on 19.07.2023.
